LanguageData.FGL_TrimStaticAtlasesTip: Bakes each static atlas only as tall as its textures reach, instead of a power-of-two height that is often half empty. The atlases take less memory and bake faster, and every texture keeps its pixel position. Takes effect after restarting the game.
LanguageData.FGL_DeduplicateStaticAtlasesTip: RimWorld bakes a minifiable building's texture into the Building, Item and Misc atlases. Only the Building copy is baked; minified buildings and blueprints draw from it. Takes effect after restarting the game.
LanguageData.FGL_FastStaticAtlasCompressionTip: Compresses the baked static atlases in Unity's standard mode instead of its high-quality mode, which adds dithering and takes longer. Takes effect after restarting the game.
LanguageData.FGL_TextureResizingExplanation: Some mods may contain a lot of high-res textures that take a long time to load. Use this to downscale hi-res textures. Original files will NOT be modified; downscaled versions are stored in a separate cache and loaded automatically on next startup. Following textures will be reduced down to target size: Building - 256px Pawn - 256px Apparel - 128px Weapon - 128px Item - 128px Plant - 128px Tree - 256px Terrain - 1024px
LanguageData.FGL_DownscaleTexturesUnavailable: Graphics Settings+ or Image Opt is loading textures, so the downscale tool is unavailable.
LanguageData.FGL_DownscaleTexturesConfirmation: Perform texture downscaling? Downscaled textures will be cached separately; original mod files will not be modified.(requires restart once)
LanguageData.FGL_ClearTextureCacheConfirmation: Clear all cached downscaled textures? Original textures will be used on next startup.
LanguageData.FGL_TextureCacheStatus_Empty: Texture cache is empty. No textures have been downscaled.
